valve_rat.who: 1990s moonshine-still valve rat, a short wiry old sewer-and-still tinkerer who wears a brass twin-tank pack on his back and shoots darts out of a brass pipe fed by it
valve_rat.design: WEARING a greasy dark grey flat newsboy cap, a dark leather eye patch strapped over the left eye, a worn brown canvas work jacket with patched elbows, a grimy cream shirt under it, dark grey work trousers, scuffed black boots, and ON HIS BACK a big tarnished BRASS TWIN-TANK PACK: two rounded brass cylinders side by side, strapped on with two dark leather shoulder straps that cross his chest, the tanks' domed tops with small valve wheels rising clearly above both shoulders behind his head and the tanks' sides showing past his waist on both sides; a small wiry natural build, a short man (about four feet tall), STANDING TALL AND UPRIGHT with a straight back, chest out, head up and looking straight ahead at the camera, long thin arms, bare hands
valve_rat.face: a stylized game-character face, slightly caricatured but natural and clearly readable: a narrow weathered face lit evenly, one wide-open right eye with a clear white and a dark pupil under a bushy grey brow, the dark eye patch over the other eye, a long pointed nose, a sly crooked grin showing a gap tooth, short neat grey stubble on the chin, short close-cropped grey hair at the temples tucked under the cap (no wild or spiky hair), clean readable skin, the face fully in light under the cap's peak
valve_rat.texture: valve rat, dark grey flat cap, black leather eye patch, brown canvas work jacket with patched elbows, cream shirt, dark grey trousers, black boots, tarnished brass twin-tank pack on his back with dark leather straps, weathered tan skin, short grey stubble, short grey hair, one clear eye with a white, bare hands, empty hands, no weapon, no pipe
valve_rat.extra_note: The second reference image is this same character's earlier concept: keep his face, eye patch, cap, jacket and colours from it, but he now stands tall and upright with a straight back and his head up (not stooped, not hunched, not looking down), his hair is short and close-cropped, and he wears the brass twin-tank pack on his back. The third reference image shows the old figure from the side and back only for the brass twin-tank pack (two rounded brass tanks strapped high on the back): copy that pack, not the figure.
